title: Block Wizard
description:
WARNING: This game contains flashing images that some users may find uncomfortable. 
It may not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Please be advised before playing.Info:Block Wizard is an arcade puzzle game that aims to challenge both your wits and speed!

As you awaken inside the fiendish labyrinth, the only goal in sight is a flight of stairs.

What awaits on the other side?Features:• Race through each one of the 100 floors, and climb to the top, avoiding the nightmares in your way.
• Change between a retro look or modern pixel art!

• Solve challenging puzzles using your unique ability to modify the environment at will with your magic!

• Play using responsive controls requiring precision and speed! 

• Use the in-game clock to beat your own scores!

What's the fastest you can climb?

DEMO FEATURES
• Experience the first 20 levels
• Carry over your progress to the full game!

FULL GAME
• Unlock all 100 levels!
• Save your highscore on the leaderboards!
• Use Level Select to practice any stage you want!
• Set the best score for each Wing and top the leaderboards!
• Use CHAOS mode to face every floor in a randomized order for a true test of skill. Pickups from previous levels do NOT carry over.

Are you the real Block Wizard?
description_short: Block Wizard in an arcade puzzle game that features 100 levels. Use your character's unique abilities to manipulate the environment and solve mind-bending puzzles! What's the fastest you can climb?
